# Desktop capture source

The Linux and Windows sources under `../../linux/capture` and
`../../windows/capture` originate from the MIT-licensed camera_desktop 2.0.0
pub.dev archive:

https://pub.dev/api/archives/camera_desktop-2.0.0.tar.gz

Archive SHA-256:

280ce2b335f3a6d2bd4345c9906697d86de40065d52cd6090df28a8b52b32304

The matching copyright and license are preserved in LICENSE and the owning
package's root LICENSE so Flutter includes them in its bundled notices. The owning
package maintains these native sources so capture output locations and
release acknowledgements can meet its file and device ownership contract.
Android and shared Darwin capture continue to use their existing code.

Upstream build files are replaced by the owning plugin's build files.
